name: Fractal Dimension (FD) of bundle masks
summary: Computes the box-counting fractal dimension of each bundle mask in a tract-mask collection and outputs the values as a CSV table.
description: For every NIfTI mask in the collection, counts the boxes needed to cover the mask at box sizes from 1 up to box_size_max and fits the log-log slope to get the fractal dimension, a measure of the irregularity of the bundle shape. Use it to compare the shape complexity of white matter bundles across subjects or methods.

inputs.description: Collection of bundle masks of which to compute the Fractal Dimension

outputs.description: csv file with the Fractal Dimension of each bundle mask of the collection

parameters.description: Maximum size of the box used by the box-counting method

citations.text: Berto G, et al. Classifyber, a robust streamline-based linear classifier for white matter bundle segmentation. NeuroImage (2020).

failure_modes.fix: Check that the input contains NIfTI bundle masks.
